name: Žatec and the Landscape of Saaz Hops
description: In northwestern Czechia, along the Ohře River, Žatec sits at the heart of the farmland that grows Saaz hops, the prized variety used by brewers worldwide. Visitors can wander fields farmed for centuries, old hop-drying and processing buildings, and a medieval town centre. The 19th- and 20th-century hop warehouses of the Prague Suburb add an industrial layer.
